data.name: Adivin
data.long_meaning: Adivin is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ada' (knowledge, wisdom) and 'Vin' (seer, prophet). This name is given to a child who is believed to possess extraordinary wisdom and the ability to foresee future events. Adivin is a revered and respected name in Hindu tradition, associated with spiritual leaders, sages, and prophets.
